title: Remote failure wording
responsibility: Convert failures to remote error codes and messages, suppressing unsafe ordinary error text.

inputs.name: remoteFailureText.error
inputs.description: Failure to describe; declared RemoteFailure values retain their code and message.

inputs.name: remoteFailureText.roots
inputs.description: Project roots to hide when inspecting ordinary errors; defaults to an empty list, with the home directory also considered.

outputs.name: remoteFailureText
outputs.description: Declared remote failure unchanged, or code failed with an ordinary message only when short, nonempty and free of detected paths; otherwise generic failure wording.
